There is no three-day count, and the psalm is reduced to his being one who glorifies. The counterfactual of staying in the belly until the Resurrection has no Hebrew counterpart.

sides.note: The cry from the fish is a warning, not a model: Jonah 2:3 qārāʾtî mi-ṣṣārāh lî ʾel YHWH wa-yyaʿănēnî, a psalm of thanksgiving. Q 68:48 fa-ṣbir li-ḥukmi rabbika wa-lā takun ka-ṣāḥibi l-ḥūti idh nādā wa-huwa makẓūm: the call made 'choked with grief/anger' is held up as what the prophet must not imitate. Jonah is unnamed, 'the companion of the fish'.
